items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Deek Watson who is one of the Ink Spots now, took the name and started the Ink Spots with Bill Kenny 'cause he's from Indianapolis -- Deek.

ctx.x: And then I played all the biggest theaters in Indianapolis from the New Royal, which is the biggest theater, and we got to Indianapolis, you know, I got a trio together. See it was only Buck and Bubbles at the time and then I got a little boy called Sugar Babe and we put him in the act and made a trio and we were the first Ink Spots, you

know. Buck and Bubbles and Sugar Babe were the first Ink Spots out of Indianapolis, Indiana, where Deek Watson who is one of the Ink Spots now, took the name and started the Ink Spots with Bill Kenny 'cause he's from Indianapolis -- Deek.

However, the Lyric Theater in Indianapolis is where we did the act called the three Ink Spots. It was sensational. We played in the Royal Theater which is the biggest theater in Indianapolis and I played the Two Johns and I played the Senate Theater and played every theater they had that was more or less worth our playing.
